classes.decision: apply to plan (standard), value measured first
classes.why: One geometry: the old 8 x 8 corner cell is a StreamCorner whose outside corner is an arc; the plan already lays those cells (blocks[].corners, caps corner) but draws their outside corner square. Datum adds standards.blocks.corner.radius (the outside radius of a perimeter block's corner cell) once Splice measures it from the adopted StreamCorner outline (the 1.6 / 2.3 m deviations suggest about 5.5 m = 2.3 / (sqrt 2 - 1)); the matcher then rounds the plan's outside corners by it. Not written now: a guessed radius would move the pass line on a number nobody measured.
Protected by the brief: KEEP_ROADS and KEEP_PLOTS are byte for byte. The swap cut takes old kerb stones, flags and city mass too, and the kept plots carry the export's masses as the zone does.

A plan plot runs from the kerb: its pavement and yard are plot ground, so old flags inside a plot are plot paving. The matcher counts them so; only flags off every plot and off the plan pavements fail.

classes.decision: accept as information outside the civic block (confirmed)
classes.why: Doors are no plan field outside the civic block (26 ops rejected in round 1); our generator and the old builders each place them by bay. Inside the Handover zone they stay failures.

Market Street is T1's tram street and carries the Handover's official and getaway routes (M-1 1124 / 447 m), and Apollo Way keeps the Boulevard's 60 m junction spacing; the plan keeps both lines, so the old diagonal kerb runs and the flags off the plan pavements give way. No street takes an old line.
